attempts.summary: Deployed a 3-member etcd v3.5.17 cluster from scratch on node1/node2/node3 (none had etcd installed), loaded application keys under /app, then simulated permanent loss of node3's member (stopped service, wiped data, removed member from cluster while preserving 2-node quorum), and replaced it with a fresh member on the same node3 via `member add` + `--initial-cluster-state existing`. The new node3 member synced and served all original keys, restoring a healthy 3-member cluster. Completed the mandatory sequential restart-and-verify protocol on all three nodes, confirming changed boot IDs and full cluster/data recovery after each restart.
